name: 70139 · New Orleans, LA
findings: ZIP 70139 (New Orleans) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (8%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 70139 (New Orleans) has 6 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
